english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an emotional or trauma-related stimulus that sets off a reaction.

examples.english: This song is a trigger for my emotional outbursts.
examples.traditional: 呢首歌係我情緒爆發嘅觸發點。
examples.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 ngo5 cing4 seoi5 baau3 faat3 ge3 zuk1 faat3 dim2
